label: HOST_ORACLE_VISUAL_FEASIBILITY
question: IF SpectraSynq possessed correct harmonic-state and harmonic-movement information, would that information enable a visual behaviour worth pursuing?
explicitly_independent_of: whether the current frontend can recover it. That is J3D / C1 / C1b territory and remains unresolved. VALUE != RECOVERABILITY != COMPUTE COST.

oracle.source: exact BabySlakh MIDI, unchanged from J3D-A
oracle.state: 12-D duration-overlap weighted pitch-class state, NO velocity weighting, L1-normalised
oracle.percussion_exclusion: is_drum OR General MIDI program >= 112 - identical to J3D-A
must_not: alter the J3D oracle to improve visual behaviour

challenge_set.membership: REUSED from J3D-A v2, recomputed by the identical code path and ASSERTED against the v2 receipt counts
challenge_set.on_mismatch: the run is INVALID. Membership must never be reselected from rendering results.
challenge_set.ordinary_holdout: all valid frames not in any challenge class

visual_verb.name: HARMONIC COLOUR TRANSITION
visual_verb.semantics: tonal state changes -> visual colour state changes. NOT 'harmonic movement rises -> brightness rises'.

state_to_colour.reuse: existing SpectraSynq chroma->colour semantics, not a new colour theory
state_to_colour.rule: pitch-class bin b maps to hue b/12 on the wheel; bin weight is the SQUARED chromagram drive, which is the documented firmware bloom path (hsv(..., bin^2/6), then RGB squared again); the frame's target colour is the weight-normalised mix of those 12 hues
state_to_colour.shaping: edgeai.mir.host_chroma.bloom_chromagram with its frozen floor=0.65, applied identically to both conditions

frozen.strip: uniform - no new spatial verb is invented

movement_to_transition.rule: harmonic movement controls ONLY the transition rate between successive tonal colour states: alpha(t) = A_MIN + (A_MAX - A_MIN) * clip(M(t)/M_REF, 0, 1); colour(t) = (1-alpha)*colour(t-1) + alpha*target(t)
movement_to_transition.M_REF_justification: 0.35 is the median M_tv of the J3D challenge frames' CHROMA baseline (0.349 / 0.373), i.e. a scale taken from the CONTROL side, not the treatment side, so it cannot favour the oracle
forbidden: any tuning after seeing a score

compositor.photons: HELD FIXED at 1.0 for both conditions, so luminance carries no information and the metric cannot degenerate to brightness

conditions.CONTROL: host_chroma12 -> the SAME state->colour mapping; host chroma movement -> the SAME transition engine. This is the strongest relevant control; onset/RMS are diagnostic references only.
conditions.TREATMENT: oracle pitch-class state -> the SAME state->colour mapping; oracle M_tv -> the SAME transition engine.
conditions.invariant: same renderer, same degrees of freedom, same frozen constants. ONLY the musical information differs.

temporal_views.CONSUMER_TIME: each series on its declared causal/nominal timeline. No lag correction. J3D's chroma timing is unresolved and no receptive-field correction is authorised because C1 did not establish one.

EVENT_TOLERANT.justification: 2 hops is 64 ms, the figure the cadence receipt already records as the actual added delay at the 20 Hz transport edge. It is a correspondence WINDOW for event metrics only - the signal is never shifted and no lag is optimised.

metric.visual_transition_magnitude: CIELAB Delta-E between consecutive rendered frames, computed on the sRGB-encoded rendered LED bytes
metric.why_not_luminance: the visual verb is a colour transition; mean luminance is explicitly forbidden and photons are held fixed so luminance carries nothing

response_threshold.rule: per condition, the 90th percentile of that condition's OWN ordinary-holdout Delta-E distribution
response_threshold.why: FAIRNESS CONTROL. A per-condition threshold prevents TREATMENT winning merely by being more active overall. Each condition is judged against its own resting behaviour.

measures: harmonic challenge recall: fraction of HARMONIC_CHANGE_FLAT_ENERGY and HARMONIC_CHANGE_NO_ONSET frames with a response within the tolerance window
acoustic-only false response: same fraction on ACOUSTIC_CHANGE_LOW_HARMONIC_CHANGE
ordinary-holdout chatter: above-threshold rate, median Delta-E, and a direction-reversal rate as an oscillation measure

outcome_thresholds.HARMONIC_VISUAL_CARRIER_FAIL: TREATMENT harmonic recall (event-tolerant, mean of the two harmonic classes) < 0.50. Even with perfect information the grammar does not respond at harmonic events. This fails the GRAMMAR, not harmonic intelligence.
outcome_thresholds.HARMONIC_VISUAL_INFORMATION_GAIN: carrier works (TREATMENT harmonic recall >= 0.50) AND [ TREATMENT harmonic recall exceeds CONTROL by >= 0.10 absolute on BOTH harmonic classes OR TREATMENT acoustic-only false response is at least 0.10 lower than CONTROL ] AND TREATMENT ordinary-holdout above-threshold rate is not more than 1.5x CONTROL's
outcome_thresholds.HARMONIC_VISUAL_NO_INCREMENT: carrier works but neither gain criterion is met
outcome_thresholds.HARMONIC_VISUAL_INCONCLUSIVE: anything else, including a gain on one axis accompanied by pathological holdout behaviour

artefact.when: only if the machine result is HARMONIC_VISUAL_INFORMATION_GAIN
artefact.selection: excerpts chosen from J3D challenge membership BEFORE rendering - never after looking at output
artefact.status: decision support for Captain, NOT an automatic perceptual gate, NOT D25/C1, does not reopen Gate C

forbidden_in_this_job: calling a high transfer score good lighting

pre_score_clarifications.subject: bloom_chromagram's floor=0.65
pre_score_clarifications.finding: bloom_chromagram compresses the 12 bins into [0.65, 1.0]. That floor exists so a sparse one-hot does not render BLACK in the bloom engine - it is a brightness accommodation for that engine, not a colour-mix rule. Applied to a hue MIX it washes every frame toward white and would bias this job toward CARRIER_FAIL.
pre_score_clarifications.decision: compute BOTH weightings and report both: (a) with_floor - the product-faithful bloom drive, squared; (b) without_floor - the squared L1-normalised state, the bin^2 semantics alone. Both are applied IDENTICALLY to CONTROL and TREATMENT, so neither can bias the comparison between them. The with_floor variant additionally tests, inside the sandbox, the compatibility pin's own warning that palette-locked hue is a weak observable.
pre_score_clarifications.primary: without_floor is the primary variant for the outcome classification, because the floor is a bloom-engine brightness accommodation and this sandbox is not the bloom engine. with_floor is reported alongside.

pre_score_clarifications.subject: smoothing space
pre_score_clarifications.decision: the transition smoother runs on linear RGB before the sRGB preview encode - a straight-line path through colour space. Declared so it is not chosen after seeing output.

pre_score_clarifications.subject: the ordinary-holdout chatter guard is vacuous as first written
pre_score_clarifications.finding: the response threshold is defined as the 90th percentile of each condition's OWN ordinary-holdout Delta-E. That makes the holdout above-threshold rate exactly 0.10 for BOTH conditions by construction, so the criterion 'TREATMENT holdout rate <= 1.5x CONTROL' is always satisfied and protects against nothing.
pre_score_clarifications.decision: the OPERATIVE chatter guard becomes the DIRECTION-REVERSAL RATE on ordinary holdout: the fraction of holdout frames where consecutive colour-trajectory steps reverse direction (dot product of successive colour deltas < 0). It is threshold-independent and measures oscillation directly. Guard: TREATMENT reversal rate <= 1.5 x CONTROL reversal rate. Set now, before any score exists.
pre_score_clarifications.the_original_criterion: still computed and reported, flagged as vacuous, so the record shows what was replaced and why.
